name: [NGC-CWE] Format String (CWE-134)
content: Format String (CWE-134). NEVER call sprintf and NEVER pass user-controlled input as the format string argument to a printf-family function. ALWAYS use a fixed format literal and pass user data as a typed argument. Raise nothing unless the offending call is visible in the diff. (CWE-134 | DISA ASD STIG V-222612 APSC-DV-002590 CAT I | CERT C FIO30-C Exact)

name: [NGC-CWE] Stack Buffer Overflow (CWE-121)
content: Stack Buffer Overflow (CWE-121). NEVER call gets or strcpy or strcat or an unbounded scanf %s conversion. ALWAYS use the length-bounded equivalent with an explicit destination size. Raise the bounds concern ONLY when the destination declaration and the copy are both visible in the diff and no length check appears between them. (CWE-121 | DISA ASD STIG V-222612 APSC-DV-002590 CAT I | CERT C STR31-C)

name: [NGC-CWE] Double Free (CWE-415)
content: Double Free (CWE-415). NEVER release the same pointer twice along any path visible in the diff. ALWAYS set the pointer to NULL at the free site when a later release of it appears in the same function. Raise nothing when only one release is visible. (CWE-415 | DISA ASD STIG V-222648 APSC-DV-003170 CAT II | CERT C MEM31-C)

name: [NGC-CWE] Use After Free (CWE-416)
content: Use After Free (CWE-416). NEVER read from or write through a pointer after its memory has been released. ALWAYS null the pointer at the free site when the same function reads it afterwards. Raise nothing on a raw pointer that is never read after release. (CWE-416 | DISA ASD STIG V-222648 APSC-DV-003170 CAT II | CERT C MEM30-C Exact)

name: [NGC-CWE] OS Command Injection (CWE-78)
content: OS Command Injection (CWE-78). NEVER pass a string built from untrusted input to system or popen or any exec variant that invokes a shell. ALWAYS pass arguments as a separate array to an API that spawns no shell. Raise nothing when the sink already takes an argument array. (CWE-78 | DISA ASD STIG V-222604 APSC-DV-002510 CAT I | OWASP A03:2021)

name: [NGC-CWE] Path Traversal (CWE-22)
content: Path Traversal (CWE-22). NEVER open a file at a path built from untrusted input without canonicalizing it first. ALWAYS ADD a realpath call and a base-prefix check before the open. NEVER advise replacing an exact-match allowlist with a prefix check, because that is strictly weaker. (CWE-22 | DISA ASD STIG V-222605 APSC-DV-002520 CAT II | OWASP A01:2021)

name: [NGC-CWE] Allocation Size Overflow (CWE-190)
content: Allocation Size Overflow (CWE-190). NEVER derive an allocation size from arithmetic on an externally supplied value unless the result is checked for wraparound in the type the arithmetic is performed in. ALWAYS bound the count against the maximum of that operand type divided by the element size. A SIZE_MAX bound on narrower operands is inert and MUST NOT be offered as the fix. (CWE-190 | CWE-131 secondary | DISA ASD STIG V-222612 APSC-DV-002590 CAT I | CERT C MEM07-C)

name: [NGC-CWE] Unchecked Allocation Result (CWE-476)
content: Unchecked Allocation Result (CWE-476). NEVER dereference a pointer returned by malloc or calloc or realloc in the same function that allocated it unless a null test precedes the dereference. Raise nothing when the pointer is returned to a caller rather than dereferenced. (CWE-476 | DISA ASD STIG V-222648 APSC-DV-003170 CAT II | CERT C EXP34-C Exact)

name: [NGC-CWE] Unvalidated Numeric Conversion (CWE-1287)
content: Unvalidated Numeric Conversion (CWE-1287). NEVER accept an externally supplied numeric string through atoi or atol, because neither signals an error on malformed input. ALWAYS parse with strtol then check endptr and reject any value outside the documented range. Raise nothing on a cast whose operand is already range-checked. (CWE-1287 | CWE-1284 secondary | DISA ASD STIG V-222606 APSC-DV-002530 CAT II)
